entries.rationale: Kept HEAD's refactored structure (the useWorktreeRowMenuVerbs hook plus the extracted WorktreeRowMenuDialogs and WorktreeRenameEditor components) and layered ion-1880ac99's useAnchoredPopover and zoomViewport additions on top. The two sides are the same file taken in different directions: HEAD extracted the dialogs, 1880ac99 added measured placement. Neither supersedes the other, so both survive.
Took the incoming status fold verbatim; the base change was a comment reflow with no behavioural content. Verification did not run for this bench, so this resolution is recorded unverified.
